Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misinterpreted the 1887 “Declaration of Amity and Commerce” (establishment of diplomatic relations) as an “alliance.” The task asks when Thailand (birthplace country: Bangkok, Thailand) formed an alliance with Japan, which refers to the WWII wartime alliance (1941). By equating a diplomatic relations anniversary (130 years in 2017 → 1887) with an alliance, the agent drew an incorrect conclusion and diverted the plan away from the correct 1941 alliance date.
